sources.title: How do we manage consent in practice?
sources.supports: Prior consent for non-exempt storage/access, informed third-party/purpose-specific choices and withdrawal with equivalent ease. Remembered settings need appropriate explanation. No fixed universal statutory consent lifetime.

decisions.conclusion: Do not globally auto-connect Google for unchosen visitors. Offer informed map-specific choice; remembered permission may auto-show larger maps on later pages until expiry/withdrawal.

Minimize/version/expire remembered preference; equal refusal, easy withdrawal, storage failure safe fallback, cross-tab/back-forward behavior, no ad-consent conflation. A30-day duration is a project choice, not statutory universal rule.
Use reviewed official Share embeds, preserve provider attribution, avoid copied screenshot/maps imagery and others' API keys.

Initial browser failure followed by successful official e-Gov API retrieval. Current law27-12 and rule22-2-27/28/29 read: information-viewing services can be within specified categories; applicable disclosures/conditions concern readable Japanese/easy access, transmitted information, handling entity name and purpose, with statutory exceptions including qualifying consent. Compare actual role/service/data flows; do not call all introduction sites exempt or all project operations certified.

Assess actual targeting and processing; where GDPR or other privacy duties apply they can apply to current operations independently of advertising or monetization. Necessary real controller/rights-response information cannot be invented or deferred merely because AdSense is off. Actual required operator information and applicability remain unresolved.
Keep ordinary links until genuine program/item approval, clear notices before earning links, record material connections and no invented reviewer/AI-person endorsement.
Keep off. Actual account/site ownership, ad mode, privacy/CMP and provider conditions are separate. No guaranteed approval; map choice is not a Google-certified ad CMP.

No unauthorized official photographs/hotlinks or creative-expression copying. AI output requires similarity/reliance review and non-misleading presentation; AI label alone is not permission or rights clearance.

Keep source-backed materials/price markets and verified purchase-option limits. No medical/allergy/comfort guarantee, fabricated use, tax-free/lowest-price assumption or product-sales ranking disguised as tourism ranking.

Official current Article11 checked against actual introduction-only functionality. No on-site order/booking/payment/paid service or joint-supply seller role identified; do not fabricate seller identity. Re-evaluate actual role/contracts if they change; no universal exemption certified.

GitHub Pages commercial hosting suitability remains unresolved and important before monetization. Verify with provider or migrate to suitable host; no explicit affiliate-editorial safe harbor confirmed.

Use own schematic geometry or licensed geographic data with provenance and required attribution. Do not repurpose Google imagery; indicate editorial/approximate nature and no empty-prefecture product promises.

Current compared UI said Google with an official Privacy link. For clearer rule22-2-29 handling-entity identification, recommend naming Google LLC and Google Ireland Limited as applicable to region/processing in the map Privacy section. The generic label alone does not establish a legal violation; neither does the Google name establish compliance. UK and EEA/Swiss controller assignments must not be conflated; do not assign all Maps visitor data to the separate indexed/displayed-information controller.
